name: Christoffel
beschreibung:
The traditional Gasthaus Christoffel welcomes travellers to Hopfgarten in the Brixen valley with rustic charm and attentive service. Well-tended rooms provide a cosy retreat overlooking the Kitzbuehel Alps.

The nearby Hopfgarten gondola provides immediate entry to the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental. In summer, scenic trails to panoramic peaks start close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthaus Christoffel in Hopfgarten im Brixental offers traditional hospitality and alpine dining at the foot of Hohe Salve.
